payload.summary: Greeting fixture is a two-file surface: src/greeting.mjs currently exports only greet (Hello, ${name}!); src/farewell.mjs does not exist. Required validators are registered in .harness/project.yaml (fixture-greeting -> node scripts/validate.mjs, contract-test -> node scripts/contract.mjs, both required) plus scripts/architecture.mjs via package.json check:architecture. npm test runs validate.mjs; check:architecture runs architecture.mjs.
